systems.tiers: A ministry's pilot social registry since 2015, covering households in 15 communes and 64,424 individuals, planned for 22 communes by mid-2022 and national coverage by 2028; no commune office is said to work in it

note: The document names communes as project locations, as holders of Communal Development Plans and as pilot sites for a digital payment system for beneficiaries; nothing is stated about a commune office's connection, equipment or systems.
